title: Roughdraft Flavored Markdown Review Index
description: A JSON review index for comments and suggestions parsed from Roughdraft Flavored Markdown. The Markdown source remains the normative storage format.

source.description: The document the index was built from. Conformance fixtures carry it so they are self-contained; an API exposing an index for a document the caller already holds may omit it.

markdown.description: The complete Markdown source that produced this review index.

frontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter content when exposed separately by the parser.

endmatter.description: YAML endmatter content when exposed separately by the parser.

metadata.description: Record keys from the endmatter that this specification does not define, preserved as parsed.

anchor.description: The resolved location of a comment's anchor element in the body.

kind.description: span anchors inline text within a single block, point anchors a location with no text of its own.

text.description: The text enclosed by the anchor element. Absent for a point anchor.

markdown.description: The content enclosed by the anchor element before Markdown rendering, when available.

body.description: Comment text as Markdown, taken from the endmatter record's body.

re.description: The comment or suggestion this replies to.

scope.description: Present when the comment is about the document as a whole.
A comment about the document as a whole has no anchor.

kind.description: Read from the anchor element: ins inserts, del deletes, and a span wrapping both replaces.

text.description: The inserted or deleted text, for insert and delete suggestions.

oldText.description: The text the document has now, for replace suggestions.

newText.description: The text the edit proposes, for replace suggestions.

commentIds.description: Ids of comments whose re names this suggestion.
